datasets.name: CGHD (Circuit Graph Hand-Drawn)
datasets.version_seen: Zenodo version 16 (2025-10-25), record describes 3269 annotated images and 59 object classes
datasets.license: Zenodo dataset record: CC-BY-4.0. The GitHub repository DFKI/cghd is marked CC0-1.0; that repository license is not a substitute for the Zenodo dataset license.
datasets.citation: Thoma, Bayer, Li, Dengel. A Public Ground-Truth Dataset for Handwritten Circuit Diagram Images. ICDAR 2021. Dataset: Bayer et al., Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.17469897.
datasets.what_it_contains: Hand-drawn circuit photographs, Pascal VOC boxes, some segmentation maps and ASC netlists.
datasets.use_in_electrobench: Cross-style raster-to-graph generalization. Not Chinese switchgear, and not a substitute for the synthetic GB/T volume.

datasets.name: Open Schematics
datasets.version_seen: Dataset card retrieved 2026-11-27, license tag cc-by-4.0
datasets.license: Dataset card declares CC-BY-4.0 and tells users to also comply with the licenses of the original hardware projects the files were collected from.
datasets.what_it_contains: KiCad and other EDA schematic sources with rendered images and partial structured component metadata.
datasets.use_in_electrobench: Example of paired source and render. Electronics schematics, not GB/T switchgear single-line diagrams.

datasets.name: FloorPlanCAD
datasets.version_seen: Project site retrieved 2026-11-27; site says the project shut down in early 2022
datasets.license: Project site: annotations and the website are CC BY-NC 4.0, and the authors state they do not own the drawing copyright. The Voxel51 Hugging Face card tag says cc-by-sa-4.0 while the card body repeats CC BY-NC 4.0. Treat the project-site statement as the one to follow, and do not assume commercial rights.
datasets.citation: Fan, Zhu, Li, Chen, Zhu, Tan. FloorPlanCAD: A Large-Scale CAD Drawing Dataset for Panoptic Symbol Spotting. ICCV 2021.
datasets.what_it_contains: Architectural floor-plan CAD with vector primitives and raster PNG. Not electrical schematics.
datasets.use_in_electrobench: Methodology reference for vector symbol spotting only.

datasets.name: P&ID symbol detection code and PID_dataset
datasets.version_seen: Zenodo record 8028570 (2023-06-12); GitHub repository default branch main
datasets.license: GitHub code repository: MIT (copyright 2024 Mohit Gupta). The Zenodo dataset metadata retrieved on 2026-11-27 did not state a license. Do not redistribute the Zenodo archive until a license is confirmed.
datasets.citation: Gupta, Wei, Czerniawski. Semi-supervised symbol detection for piping and instrumentation drawings. Automation in Construction 159 (2024) 105260. Dataset: doi:10.5281/zenodo.8028570.
datasets.what_it_contains: Industrial P&ID sheets and symbol labels. The code demonstrates overlapping-patch inference.
datasets.use_in_electrobench: Pipeline reference for large-sheet symbol detection. P&ID symbols are not mapped onto GB/T 4728 switchgear classes in this repo.

datasets.name: LEEPHARMA_SLD1
datasets.version_seen: Universe page retrieved 2026-11-27: 315 images, 31 classes including circuit breaker, current transformer, fuse, motor, voltmeter
datasets.license: The retrieved page did not state a license. Check the Universe license control before download or training. This repo does not mirror the images.
datasets.citation: Roboflow Universe, LEEPHARMA_SLD1, workspace 02MAIN SINGLE LINE DIAGRAM Sheet13 05102018 1.
datasets.use_in_electrobench: Candidate external style set. Class names are the dataset's own strings; map them onto ElectroBench codes only after reading the label list.
